articles.title: 48 Teams, 104 Matches, One Trophy: The 2026 World Cup Is Set to Shatter Records
articles.summary: The 2026 FIFA Men’s World Cup expands to 48 nations, the largest field ever. Opening in Mexico City on June 11 and concluding at New Jersey’s MetLife Stadium on July 19, the tournament features a new format with 12 groups and a 32-team knockout stage. Expect chaos, drama, and history.

articles.title: Floetry’s Tiny Desk Concert Is a Joyful, Soulful Reunion a Decade in the Making
articles.summary: British R&B duo Floetry — Natalie Stewart and Marsha Ambrosius — played NPR’s Tiny Desk during their first tour in ten years. Their set mixed nostalgia, humor, and stunning vocals, from the U.K. homage “Big Ben” to the Michael Jackson hit “Butterflies.” The chemistry was undeniable.

articles.title: Tennessee’s Koby Bujak-Upton Drops Three Lifetime Bests Ahead of High-Stakes Australian Trials
articles.summary: Rising Tennessee sophomore Koby Bujak-Upton clocked personal bests in the 50, 100, and 200 freestyle at the MAC Charlotte Open, just weeks before the Australian Trials. Already the fastest freshman ever in the 200-yard free, he’s peaking at the perfect moment. Teen phenom David Sammons also rewrote his record book.
